title: $399 Robot Duck Learned to Walk Before Step 1
description: Microduck, a small walking robot from Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics, learned to walk in a simulation before its first real step: falling and retrying over and over, then carrying that skill into the real robot. It's about 25 cm tall and under 800 g. Its software is open source, but Pollen says the hardware designs are not. $399 before tax and shipping; new orders are estimated at 4–6 months (as of Oct 2026; timing may change). At Nvidia GTC Berlin the live demo robots stumbled. Real floors are still hard. Hugging Face's CEO says it's heading for about 20,000 preorders (his forecast, not a confirmed figure). Follow for more hopeful science. Sources: Pollen Robotics, Engadget, TNW, TechCrunch, The Gadgeteer. Visuals are our own recordings and illustrative graphics, not footage of the actual robot or event. #Robotics #AI #HuggingFace #Microduck
